description: Holds expense trip details records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to expense trips.
business_purpose: Used to track and report expense trip details records, including amounts and quantities, for the Accounts & Finance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one expense trip detail.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the expense trip detail.

columns.name: expense_tripId
columns.description: Reference to the expense trips linked to this expense trip detail.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Category of the expense trip detail.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount of the expense trip detail.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Free-text description for the expense trip detail.

columns.name: created_byId
columns.description: User who created the expense trip detail.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

columns.name: modified_byId
columns.description: User who last modified the expense trip detail.

columns.name: modified_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was last modified.
